full_page.content:
1937, March
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 174 Cont.
Mar. 10 Myron Bloomfield - 41 - of Mackinac Isle. very threatening eyes and unable to keep eat ... nerve trouble in jaws, etc.
Jonna Fay Curtin - 20 - Fellowship of truth - Enemia Enrolled ,arch 3rd improving but slowly .... Enrolled again To-day.
Loraine Gowenlock - 20 - operation astonishingly successful in St. Louis
Page 175
Mar. 10 Dorothy Perens - 21 - of Utah City - St. Vitis. ...
Geo McCann - 9 - severely punished
12 Mary Miller - 51 - blind now three weeks - widow five years
13 Gus Anserge - 53 July 4 - Lutheran - inward trouble - intestinal - motor man - praying 30 yrs. to be relieved of his trouble. Some- times gets discouraged, wondering if his prayers are heard etc.
V. Sister Carlotta I.H.M. - 45 - Eye - trouble - fears operation - Glucoma threatened ...
Max. Spreen - 46 - Method. - threatening groth
16
Clara C. Waterwori - Presbiterian ... anxious about stomach ... Denis Merentette - 48 - had lost balance - severe nervous break- down.
Ray Moran -
Old Mrs. Ames about 8th - fears cancer of stomach ...
Page 176 Mar. 16 Charles Husanger - 68 - serious kidney and out of work
17
Rose Cassara - 21 = T.B. in Kiefer -
Legislators - Senate & Represent ...... Judge Healy
Patrick Powers - 36 - ... fractured ... Paul Nestor - 39 - off and dope for 28 yrs. - in accidents & in jail
